Meet Emily

About

Trusted Tails is built around one idea: your pets deserve the same patience, attention, and consistency you'd give them yourself. For over five years, that's meant caring for dogs, cats, reptiles, small animals, and the occasional farm friend across Westminster, Boulder, and the surrounding area.

Every visit is shaped around your pet's actual routine — leash walks, medication schedules, mobility support, or simply company and a clean space while you're away. A background in dog training and hands-on experience with a wide range of species means high-energy pups, shy cats, and reptiles all get the same level of care.

Reliable communication is part of the service, not an afterthought — every visit comes with photo and text updates, and special circumstances are handled with the same patience as everything else.

Every pet is treated like family — because that's the standard, not the exception.
